text: If you’re an undergraduate at UC Berkeley interested in research opportunities and if you plan to pursue graduate studies, feel free to reach out to me by email with your CV, past work and publications, interests and expectations. Edit: I'm not hiring undergraduates for research positions at the moment, but I am happy to answer questions and provide advice.
